entities.summary: Yuna Shishido , known as a solo artist by the stage name Kavka Shishido  is a Japanese drummer and vocalist. Originally a member of the rock band The News, she debuted as a solo musician in 2012 and released her debut album Kavkanize in 2013. She prominently plays the drums in all of her promotions.
